FAQ

A few things you might be wondering.

Is this right for my business?

It’s designed for F&B and lifestyle brands that already have a visual identity and usable brand assets, from cafés and bakeries to homeware and gifting businesses. If you have product photos, brand materials and a website with relevant pages, we can build from there.

Do I need nine existing Instagram posts?

No. I create the nine feed designs and captions from your existing brand assets. You provide the materials: product photography, logo, colours, fonts, packaging images and a few notes on your brand.

Will the Pins look exactly like my Instagram posts?

Not always, and that’s on purpose. If a design works well on Pinterest, I adapt it. If it doesn’t, I design a Pinterest-specific Pin from your brand assets. Everything stays consistent with your brand.

Are captions and descriptions included?

Yes. You get nine Instagram captions, plus nine Pinterest titles and nine descriptions written with search in mind.

What are the eight core boards?

They’re the main homes for your Pins. Each board comes with a branded cover, a title and a description, so your content is organised and easy to find from day one.

Do I need a Pinterest account?

It helps, but this project is about creating and preparing your content. Account setup and ongoing management aren’t included.

Will you publish the content for me?

No. This is a one-time content creation and handoff. Scheduling, publishing and ongoing Instagram or Pinterest management aren’t included.

Will this increase my traffic or sales?

I can’t promise specific traffic, reach or sales, and I’d be careful with anyone who does. What I can say is that every post, Pin and board is built with strategy and search in mind, by someone who knows how Pinterest discovery works. Results depend on your products, your website, demand and how consistently you show up. I give you a strong foundation. What you do with it after handoff is what moves it forward.

How do I get the most out of my content?

Use it consistently. Post your Instagram content on a rhythm you can keep, save your Pins to the right boards, send people to the website pages I recommend and keep those pages up to date. The content is built to be found, and how far it goes grows with the effort you put in afterwards.

Why not just resize my Instagram posts for Pinterest?

Instagram and Pinterest get used differently. People scroll Instagram to follow brands they already know, and they use Pinterest to search for ideas and products. So each Pin gets a layout, title and description made for how people search on Pinterest, not a resized feed graphic.

How does payment work?

Payment is 100% upfront to confirm your project and begin work. Once it’s confirmed, I’ll send your onboarding checklist.

What do you need from me?

Your brand assets, product photography, website links and notes on your products and audience. I’ll send an onboarding checklist once your project is confirmed.

How long does it take?

9–12 business days after full payment, completed onboarding and receipt of all required materials. If anything essential is missing, I’ll tell you before confirming the timeline.

How many revisions are included?

One consolidated round for the agreed deliverables, so feedback stays focused and doesn’t turn into an open-ended redesign.

Do you create logos or provide photography?

No. I work with your existing brand identity and the photography you provide. Logo design, full brand identity and image sourcing aren’t included.

Can I request extra Pins or other services?

Yes. Extra Pins, additional boards, expanded research, account setup, publishing or ongoing management can be quoted separately.

How much does it cost, and how do I book?

$527 USD founding-client price, for the first three projects. Payment is 100% upfront to confirm your project and begin work. Once we agree it’s a fit, I’ll send onboarding next steps.

Ongoing Pinterest management

Do you offer ongoing Pinterest management?

Yes, as a separate service with a custom scope and monthly rate. It can include content planning, Pin design and copy, keyword-informed optimisation, scheduling, publishing and performance reviews.

What’s the difference between this project and management?

This project is a one-time content creation and handoff: finished designs and copy. Management is ongoing help planning, creating, publishing and refining your Pinterest content.

Can I start with this project and move to management later?

Absolutely, with no obligation to continue. We’ll look at your goals and content to see what makes sense.

How much does Pinterest management cost?

Monthly management starts with a custom quote based on your goals, publishing frequency and creative needs. Each service period is booked with full payment upfront.
